name: Make BEM model
summary: Builds a BEM conductor model for MEG/EEG forward modelling from a FreeSurfer subject with MNE-Python, running the watershed algorithm if BEM surfaces are missing, with QC figures and a report.
description: If inner skull, outer skull and outer skin surfaces are not in the subject's bem/ folder, runs mne watershed_bem; then calls mne.make_bem_model with 1 or 3 layers and the chosen ico subdivision and mne.make_bem_solution, saving the solution with a QC thumbnail and an interactive HTML report. Use 3 layers for EEG or combined MEG+EEG and 1 layer for MEG only. Needs a FreeSurfer license.

outputs.description: BEM conductor model solution (meg.fif) for forward modelling.
Interactive HTML report with BEM contours over MRI slices.

parameters.description:
n_layers=3 → (0.3, 0.006, 0.3) S/m — brain/skull/skin (for EEG)
n_layers=1 → (0.3,) S/m — inner skull only (for MEG-only)

failure_modes.message: Please set FREESURFER_LICENSE or FS_LICENSE in resource environment
failure_modes.fix: Configure a FreeSurfer license on the compute resource.
